description: This file defines a React component ContentTableView used to display a list of items (files and notes) in a tabular format with functionalities such as sorting, context menus, and item actions. It includes sub-components for rendering context menus, item icons, linked items, and other UI elements, leveraging hooks and external controllers for data management.

classes.name: ContentTableView
classes.description: Main React component for displaying a table of items with sorting, context menus, and additional actions.

classes.name: ContextMenuCell
classes.description: Component that renders a button triggering a context menu for file or note options.

classes.name: ItemLinksCell
classes.description: Component that shows linked items associated with a particular item.

classes.name: ItemNameCell
classes.description: Component that renders the item's icon, title, and backup/protection indicators.

classes.name: AttachedToCell
classes.description: Component that displays linked references to other items.

methods.name: ContentTableView
methods.description: Main component rendering the item list as a table with sorting, context menu, and row actions.

methods.name: useCallback
methods.description: React hook used multiple times to memoize functions such as onSortChange and getRowId.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: React hook used for fetching backup info when items are files.
